content: claude -p --output-format json --json-schema returns structured_output field plus session_id, usage, total_cost_usd (client estimate). Without --bare a -p session runs project .claude/settings.json hooks and .mcp.json servers of cwd without trust prompt. --bare skips OAuth login so unusable for subscription. --restricted (v2.1.248+) removes command tools, confines file tools, loads only managed settings and --settings; --safe-mode disables customizations but keeps auth. --tools '' disables built-ins, not MCP tools (use --strict-mcp-config, --disallowedTools 'mcp__*'). __SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__ splits cached system prompt. stdin capped 10MB.
